meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drive dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase, recovering inside a run with retry, amend, and send. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进先后有序的多步骤任务,出错可修改再继续
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的任务要靠步骤推进,卡住时要能修正再继续
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-step tasks in order; if one fails, amend and resume
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run tasks with multiple steps in order and need to recover when a step fails

howto.what: 它会先读规划文档，再把带依赖关系的任务拆成节点图，用工作流工具一次只跑一个阶段；每个节点等它依赖的节点完成后才执行。失败或跑偏的单个节点可单独重试或修正，已完成的节点结果会保留，不会整批重跑。
howto.when: 当你说“mass-ulw”，或提到带依赖的任务 DAG、扇出/扇入、多智能体执行等需按顺序等待的工作时触发。

say.text: 把这个任务按依赖拆开跑：先做准备工作，再并行跑两步，最后统一验证。
say.note: 会按依赖分批启动节点。

say.text: 帮我只重试那个失败的子任务，重试提示写得再具体一点。
say.note: 只会重跑失败的子任务，其他已完成节点保留。

say.text: 给正在执行的那个子任务发消息：不要改自己范围之外的内容。
say.note: 正在运行的子任务会按提示调整。

howto.what_en: Claude reads planning, builds a dependency-ordered node graph, and runs it via the workflow tool one phase per run. Nodes wait on their dependencies. Retry/send/amend fix one bad node; finished nodes keep cached results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, or mention a dependency-ordered task DAG, fan-out/fan-in, or multi-agent execution that must wait on dependencies.

say_en.text: Split this with mass-ulw: prep first, then two steps in parallel, verify.
Retry only the failed child task with a more specific prompt.
say_en.note: Only that node reruns; finished results stay cached.

say_en.text: Message the running child: don't change anything outside your scope.
say_en.note: Child continues with context and adjusts.
